name: BmiZapper
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to _primitiveToBMI, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward arbitrary external call / missing validation issue: the attacker passes a malicious aggregator address and calldata so the vulnerable contract executes USDC.transferFrom against a victim who had approved it. The PoC is a single-step exploit with minimal setup, no DeFi complexity, and only one meaningful external interaction.
